slideText.text: Do you think everyone deserves a second chance?
Who's the one person outside of your family that you would call if you only had one call before you die?
What song breaks your heart every time you hear it?
What's the one thing that you've always been scared of but too afraid to stand up for or do?
What are the most important things for you in a relationship?
What's one thing that makes you not give up even when you're at your lowest?
When did you first notice the way I looked at you changed?
Did you stalk my social media before we met? If so, what stood out?
What about me most intrigued you before we started dating?
What first caught you off guard about me in a good way?
